results.content:
The August report is likely to reinforce the view that the labor market is gradually weakening as demonstrated most clearly by slower wage growth. The fall in EPOPs also indicates weakness, although this could be at least partially reversed in August.

There was a decline in all the duration measures of unemployment in July, which ordinarily would be a positive sign, unless it was due to the longer term unemployed dropping out of the labor force. The August data will provide a clearer picture. [...] This drop in EPOPs for prime age men is an interesting twist in labor market trends.
